channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye takes helm of COP31 after climate diplomacy - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye has formally announced that it will host and preside over COP31, days after Australia withdrew its bid to host the United Nations annual climate summit.

item.title: Museums hand over operations to children for a day - Türkiye News
item.description: For one extraordinary day, Türkiye’s museums belonged entirely to children: As part of the global “Museum Takeover Day,” young visitors across the country seized control — from selling tickets and guiding tours to running official social media accounts.

item.title: Türkiye’s population nears 86 million amid declining birth rates - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye’s population has climbed to 85.98 million as of Oct. 1, official data shows, amid unprecedented declines in fertility and rising concerns over the country’s long-term demographic outlook.

item.title: Istanbul moves to curb ‘uncontrolled feeding’ of stray animals - Türkiye News
item.description: Istanbul authorities have ordered all district municipalities to immediately halt uncontrolled feeding of stray animals, accelerate shelter construction and step up the collection of stray dogs, according to a new directive issued by Türkiye’s nature conservation authority.

item.title: Pope’s Türkiye visit raises optimism for dialogue - Türkiye News
item.description: Pope Leo XIV’s first overseas visit this week in Türkiye has raised hopes and optimism for dialogue among Christians, minority rights in the country and the possible reopening of the famous Greek Orthodox seminary.

item.title: Taliban govt says Pakistan strikes on Afghanistan kill at least 10 - World News
item.description: Pakistan strikes on neighbouring Afghanistan killed at least 10 people, the Taliban government spokesman said Tuesday, a day after a suicide attack on a security compound in Pakistan's Peshawar city.

item.title: UN warns Israeli strikes threaten fragile Gaza ceasefire - World News
item.description: U.N. Deputy Special Coordinator for the Middle East Peace Process Ramiz Alakbarov said Monday that recent Israeli strikes on populated areas in Gaza are jeopardizing the fragile ceasefire, urging all parties to exercise restraint and fulfill their commitments under the agreement.

item.title: China's Xi pushes Taiwan issue in call with Trump - World News
item.description: Chinese leader Xi Jinping pressed the ever-sensitive issue of Taiwan in a phone call Monday with U.S. President Donald Trump, as he stressed the need to build on a fragile trade truce between the two superpowers.

item.title: US-Ukraine talks reduce peace proposal to 19 points: Report - World News
item.description: The U.S. peace proposal for ending the war in Ukraine has been pared back from 28 points to 19 after talks in Geneva, U.S. and Ukrainian officials said, describing the discussions as constructive but not final, U.S. media reported on Monday.

item.title: Türkiye, South Korea sign 6 deals including nuclear cooperation - Türkiye News
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan hosted South Korean President Lee Jae-myung at the Presidential Complex in the capital, Ankara, where the two countries signed six agreements covering various fields, including the Sinop Nuclear Power Plant Project.
